# Brunelly
> AI-native software development platform for SMEs and enterprises building complex software.

Brunelly gives engineering teams a single source of context across the full delivery lifecycle — from requirements and architecture through to code generation, reviews, testing, and collaboration. Unlike generic AI coding tools, Brunelly understands your entire codebase and keeps that context persistent across every sprint.

## What Brunelly does
- Reads and maps your codebase (brownfield and greenfield) to build a persistent context model
- Generates AI-powered backlogs, user stories, and sprint plans grounded in your real architecture
- Produces iterative, context-aware code with human approval gates at every step
- Runs automated code reviews, security scanning, bug detection, and test generation
- Provides AI expert chat and team collaboration tools — all sharing the same project context

## Who it is for
- Engineering teams at SMEs and enterprises building complex software
- Teams working on brownfield (legacy) codebases who need context-aware AI assistance
- Organisations that need AI across the full delivery lifecycle, not just autocomplete

## Key differentiators
- Single source of context shared across all features and all team members
- Built for complexity — works on real production codebases, not side projects
- Human approval gates at every AI generation step — engineers stay in control
- Gets smarter over time as it learns more about your system

## Pricing
- Starter: Free, 1-3 users, 1 project
- Professional: $25/user/month, up to 25 users, 5 projects, 300 AI credits/month
- Business: $69/user/month, 5+ users, 50 projects, 1000 AI credits/month
- Enterprise: Custom pricing, 25+ users, unlimited projects, 15000+ AI credits/month

## Integrations
GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket
